existimātor

existimātor, existimātōris m.

noun, third declension · Declension on Wiktionary

a judge, a critic

In this lexicon

  • critic

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Or. 112: ut existimātōrēs videāmur loquī, nōn magistrī; Cic. Brut. 200: intellegēns dīcendī existimātor; M-O s.v. review: critic
